title: Top notch!
body: Have tried many different task/checklist apps and this is far superior to most in my opinion. Easy to navigate (which is the most important part for me as I am not very tech savvy!), and as a bonus has the option to add subtasks, which makes it all quite easy to keep all your tasks organised.

title: Web platform integration?
body:
I just discovered Tasks and really like the app, but i gather Google’s recently eliminated some functionality. I haven’t been able to activate it within gmail or calendar, though discussions online suggest that ought still to be possible. It’s fruatrating not to have found any way to interface via browser, on desktop...
 A pity if it’s being phased out - Keep does not serve my purpose. 
(It’s also slow to sync across devices and the integration with Pomodone is patchy, but there PD’s probably the problem)

title: Missing the Search bar
body: This app does not have a search bar that filters the tasks in a list. This functionality is so important that the app is worth 1 star, otherwise it would be 5 stars.
